document.source_limit: Manually curated official-source snapshot retrieved 19 October 2026; not independently validated, not live C2 output, and not an official application service. Scope: the government Trade Portal's manual document-preparation snapshot after name approval, for a domestic non-BOI private company. This is company incorporation, not sole-trader business-name registration. Recorded LKR 4000 is Form 1's base fee only, excluding VAT, name reservation, Articles, director/secretary forms and all other charges. The older portal's VAT rate and turnaround are not adopted. Current eROC steps and beneficial-ownership obligations are not modeled; consult DRC before using this historical manual route. Completeness covers only this bounded task, not the agency's entire procedure or current legal compliance. Verify current requirements with the agency.
